Marta - CSM: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for NimblePay (acct NIM-145). Goal: pilot core search & chat flows in ~6 weeks. Need to align stakeholders, define success criteria, and lock a 30/60 timeline. @Devon @Priya can you confirm tech contacts and any hard blackout dates from the customer? :spiral_calendar:

Devon - Solutions Eng: Thanks — I'll take tech. Customer will use both our REST API and embeddings. Primary tech lead: Sam Park (sam@nimblepay.com). They'll need API keys + sample payloads. No blackout dates on their side for the next 6 weeks.

Priya - CSM: Adding stakeholder list from my kickoff call: 
- Maria D'Souza (Head of Product) — exec sponsor
- Sam Park (Lead Eng) — integrator
- Leo Chan (Ops) — rollout owner
- Priya listed myself as CSM
Contract renewal in 11 months (low immediate risk) but adoption needs to show value within pilot window.

Alex - Product: I can run a 45m product walkthrough + prioritized feature matrix. Available Mon/Wed mornings next week. Also have a short pre-recorded demo we can share before the kickoff.

Marta - CSM: Success criteria proposal (please +1 / edit): 
- End-to-end search latency < 250ms for 90th pct
- 3 canonical intents returning accurate answers per our evals (>= 85% pass)
- 2 internal users running daily queries by week 3
- Integration docs completed and smoke test passing

Devon - Solutions Eng: Suggested pilot sprint plan (rough):
```
Sprint 0 (week 0): API keys, env setup, sample calls
Week 1-2: Embedding index + search baseline, smoke tests
Week 3-4: Intent tuning + evals, performance tuning
Week 5-6: UAT, enablement, go/no-go decision
```
I can own Sprint 0 + perf tuning.

Priya - CSM: Risk flags: customer dev bandwidth may dip weeks 2-4 due to another internal project. Mitigation: shift heavy tuning to our side and keep weekly check-ins. Also propose a readiness checkpoint at end of week 2 for go/no-go.

Marta - CSM: Enablement plan: 
- Week 2: dev office hours (1hr) run by Devon
- Week 4: product deep dive + playbook by Alex
- Ongoing: shared prompt library + eval harness for tracking regressions
Who will own post-pilot adoption metrics? Suggest Ops (Leo) + our success metrics tracked in the Console.

Alex - Product: I'll prepare the playbook and a short checklist for internal champions. Can share by Friday.

OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "NimblePay Onboarding Kickoff" scheduled Thu 09:00 PST. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/abcdef

Marta - CSM: Action items from thread: 
- Devon: send sample payloads + quickstart guide by EOD Tues
- Alex: share playbook draft by Fri
- Priya: confirm Sam & Maria on invite and add Leo
- Marta: set weekly 30-min sync cadence starting next Mon
Please react with :thumbsup: if all good or post edits here.
